mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rose by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the last three months signals strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies benefit from increased revenues and earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% over the last three months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in the last two months signals supply chain disruptions or reduced manufacturing output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face production and profit challenges.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO dropped by more than 2% in the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in the last two months signals a strengthening housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as related industries benefit from increased activity.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% in the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in the last month, it signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 jobs in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it signals inflationary pressure in a low-rate environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS was below 1% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2% year-over-year, it signals stagflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate economic stagnation and rising prices.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% QoQ and CPIAUCSL > 2% YoY
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 grew by less than 1% QoQ and CPIAUCSL exceeded 2% YoY.
